intervention_description: Vocational case management integrated in the Clinique JAP early psychosis programme; group programme offered on admission
source_page: Abdel-Baki et al. 2013, Early Interv Psychiatry, PDF p. 2 (Programme description)
quotation: Clients are offered the group programme for a few weeks (less than 8 weeks on average) right after admission to the clinic ... All case managers participate as co-therapists in the group programme and are entirely responsible for their clients' vocational support.
note: Historical code missing and unverified; classified all_offered by RT's decision under A46

intervention_description: headspace Early Psychosis (hEP): vocational focus is a core service component, for young people wishing to address education and employment goals; local variation
source_page: Andersen et al. 2024, Aust N Z J Psychiatry 58(10), PDF p. 2 (Method, vocational support at hEP services)
quotation: all programmes ensure there is a focus on education and employment for young people wishing to address these goals through their time in the programme ... While each service differs based on local need
note: Historical code missing and unverified; availability conditional on the participant's wish is not a universal offer (A46)

intervention_description: Cluster trial in four early intervention teams that all provided IPS; two teams randomised to additional motivational interviewing training
source_page: Craig et al. 2014, Br J Psychiatry 205:145-150, PDF p. 1 (Abstract and Method)
quotation: All the participating teams included a trained vocational specialist who provided supported employment services using the IPS model.
note: Historical code all, verified; both trial arms received IPS

intervention_description: Vocational (IPS) worker introduced into one of two EIP services; the worker saw 47 service users
source_page: Dudley et al. 2014, Early Interv Psychiatry 8:98-102, PDF p. 2 (Method) and p. 4 (Results)
quotation: Service 2 did not receive vocational worker input ... The vocational worker worked with 47 service users during the year.

intervention_description: Job- and SchoolPrescription (adapted IPS) within TIPS, compared with a control group without it
source_page: Hegelstad et al. 2019, Early Interv Psychiatry 13:859-866, PDF p. 1 (Abstract)
quotation: also had employment >20 h/wk and 3 < 20 h/wk, compared to 5 in the control group

intervention_description: IPS employment specialist in an early intervention team; data collected on all clients who received a vocational intervention
source_page: Rinaldi et al. 2010, J Ment Health 19(6):483-491, PDF p. 3 (Data collection)
quotation: the team collected data monthly on all clients who received a vocational intervention
note: Historical code all, verified; every member of the sample received the intervention

intervention_description: Naturalistic early psychosis cohort; no supported employment received
source_page: Drake et al. 2013, Schizophr Res 146:111-117, PDF p. 3 (Results) and p. 4 (Discussion)
quotation: No participants received supported employment services (not shown in the table). ... No participants reported receiving supported employment
note: Lack of receipt does not establish that no vocational intervention was offered; retained as no_offer_reported

intervention_description: Both arms of the Killackey 2019 trial pooled: six months of IPS added to treatment as usual, or treatment as usual
source_page: Clarke et al. 2023 (online 2022), Qual Life Res 32:769-780, PDF p. 3 (Method)
quotation: Participants (n = 146) were randomised into either 6-months of IPS in addition
note: About half received IPS; whether usual care offered vocational provision to all is not established
